articles.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance’s EU MiCA license: WSJ
articles.snippet: Although the ECB holds no formal licensing authority under MiCA, high-level intervention led Greece to stall an application that regulators had previously deemed complete, the Journal said.

articles.title: SBI Group backs payments firm dtcpay in $25 million funding round
articles.snippet: Stablecoin payments company dtcpay completed a $25 million Series A funding round with a strategic investment from Japan’s SBI Group.

articles.title: Stablecoin payments firm dtcpay closes $25M round with SBI backing
articles.snippet: Dtcpay plans to expand its merchant network and payment products after completing a $25 million Series A backed by Japan’s SBI Group.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury firms can outperform BTC... but is the risk worth taking?

articles.title: Bitcoin Will Hit $1 Million, Says Kevin O’Leary—But There’s a Quantum Catch
